messages:
anya_marketing: Morning team — BlueMesa case study status. We have the transcript + signed release but need final copy sign-off, sanitized assets, and legal ok by Fri COB to hit next-Wed publish.

kevin_seo: I'll propose 4 SEO headlines and the meta description this afternoon. Any embargo or regional limits?

sam_cs: Customer wants NA/EU only (no APAC) and asked us to avoid vendor names and revenue figures. They approved a short pull-quote attributed to "R. Liu, VP of ML" but want the exact wording used from the signed PDF. Signed file attached.

diane_pm: Benchmarks summary ready: steady-state throughput ~3.4x, p95 down from ~480ms to ~160ms for their 1.1k token profile. I'll add a mini-methods note for the appendix with anonymized traces.

mira_design: I'll draft hero image + a two-card stat graphic. Which logo did BlueMesa prefer? Horizontal or stack?

anya_marketing: They prefer the horizontal lockup. Also: they asked to soften cost language instead of "halved inference cost" use "significantly reduced inference costs". Use the exact approved quote only when attributed.

legal_bot: Confirmed: NA/EU distribution only per customer. We must redact any internal hostnames, S3 paths, and contract numbers. Keep quote verbatim as in the signed PDF; do not add endorsements or joint-venture language. I'll attach the redaction checklist.

kevin_seo: Draft headline options: 1) "BlueMesa scales real-time inference with Redwood" 2) "How BlueMesa achieved predictable inference in production" 3) "BlueMesa sees over three times the throughput on Redwood" 4) "From pilot to production: BlueMesa's path to reliable LLM serving". Thoughts?

sam_cs: Option 2 for the case page, 1 for social, 3 as a paid test. Make sure throughput phrasing matches the customer's approved wording (they prefer "over three times").

mira_design: Uploaded draft assets to design/marketing/bluemesa-v0.4.zip. Left space for exact pull quote and stat callouts.

storage_bot: Reminder: sanitized assets must be stored at s3://redwood-marketing/bluemesa/sanitized/2026-05-12/ before PR merge. I'll run an automated redaction scan when PR opens.

anya_marketing: Customer replied: approved the softened quote and the "over three times" throughput phrasing. They asked we not publish before Wed 9am PT (their partner window). Signed release uploaded.

kevin_seo: Updated meta + a short social pack: A) "BlueMesa speeds up LLM features with Redwood — over 3x throughput" B) "BlueMesa reduces p95 latency from ~480ms to ~160ms" C) "Redwood helped BlueMesa make inference predictable and significantly reduce costs". Legal ok?

legal_bot: Stats in B are cleared (customer approved numbers). Copy C must use the customer's exact approved phrase for the pull quote if attributed; otherwise you can paraphrase the stat language so long as it's numerically accurate and matches the methods. Ensure the signed PDF is included in the PR.

diane_pm: Methods blurb uploaded: "Steady-load replay comparing BlueMesa's prior mixed-host setup to Redwood Dedicated. Identifiers removed; traces anonymized. See attached sanitized CSV."

mira_design: Final assets uploaded to design/marketing/bluemesa-hero-2026-05-11.png and design/marketing/bluemesa-stats.pdf.

anya_marketing: Opening PR now. Tagging reviewers: @kevin_seo @mira_design @diane_pm @legal_bot. Internal review deadline Thu 3pm PT. Embargo Wed 9am PT per customer.

storage_bot: PR scanned: flagged one leftover S3 path in the appendix. I've removed it and uploaded sanitized CSV to s3://redwood-marketing/bluemesa/sanitized/2026-05-12/benchmark-anon.csv. Re-scan passed.

anya_marketing: Thanks  PR up for review. Final checklist: include signed release, redaction checklist, and the sanitized benchmark CSV. Will schedule publish for Wed 9am PT pending final sign-off. :thumbsup:
